A.notes: No hard-gate failures: accessibility checks pass, the primary donate action is keyboard reachable, and reduced-motion content remains present. The root illustration gives the hero a real idea, but that idea weakens into fairly standard section blocks, and on mobile the hero/button area feels cramped and less resolved. The scroll-strip shows little meaningful motion beyond normal progression, so motion reads as minimal rather than narrative.

B.notes: No hard-gate failures: automated checks are clean, keyboard access works, and the reduced-motion version preserves all content. This has a stronger editorial concept carried through the whole page, with excellent bilingual hierarchy, a convincing public-interest tone, and a seedling illustration system that supports the story without inventing facts. From the scroll frames, the growth sequence appears to progress with scroll and serves the brief, though stills cannot confirm timing nuance.

raw.why: B is the more coherent and distinctive design overall, with much stronger typography and a motion concept that meaningfully supports the story.
